notes.source: The shapes and values a ported component is made of, in both clients. `npm run components:generate` writes `app/components.css` and the app's `Recipes.kt` from this file; a component that draws a card, a badge, a skeleton or a row reads one of these rather than typing `rounded-2xl`, `p-4` or `128.dp` (ADR-0099).
notes.tokens: A value is either a token name (`radius.2xl`, `space.card-padding`, `color.card`) or a plain number with its unit, and never both spelled differently on the two sides - that is the drift this replaces. A colour is a token name plus an optional alpha.
notes.gate: `npm run check:components` fails a stale output and a name that is not in `shared/tokens/tokens.json`. A ported component carries no visual literal: `npm run check:parity` fails one that does.

card.description: The account surface's card: the site's `rounded-2xl border border-border/50 bg-card/60`.

badge.description: The site's pill badge. Geometry is generated; the tones the port does not draw stay in `badge.tsx`, where they were.

skeleton.description: The page-level loading state: two blocks that pulse while the read is out.

row.description: One label and its numbers: muted label at the start, bold count at the end, never mirrored.
